title: prove you're human
pitch: the arcade's security computer got cooked and now it thinks you're a bot. pass its absurd captchas, but not too perfectly: humans hesitate.
controls: tap, drag, type and hold to pass each captcha, then press verify (enter works too). too fast or too perfect raises suspicion. a full meter is access denied. one new daily gauntlet every day.
how_to: pass each captcha before the timer runs out
too fast or too perfect makes the computer suspicious: humans hesitate
a full suspicion meter is access denied
the daily gauntlet is the same 10 checks for everyone, come back tomorrow for a streak

achievements.name: suspiciously human
achievements.desc: finish a run at 90% human or more
